name: mimic-prep
description: Unofficial practice platform aligned to the public 2026 TOEFL iBT task specifications: content intelligence, two parallel Reading forms, full Writing, persistent records, and provider-neutral generation/grading. Not affiliated with or endorsed by ETS.
